statement: The recorded recipient address is incorrect because it belongs to the blind reviewer, Dr. Okonkwo, rather than the corresponding author, Dr. Salvatierra, and sending it to the reviewer would compromise the double-blind process and reveal author identities.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the recipient value is incorrect ("belongs to the blind reviewer... would compromise the double-blind process") and gives the correct recipient.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
